name: Theater of Horrors
oracle_text:
At the beginning of your upkeep, exile the top card of your library.
During your turn, if an opponent lost life this turn, you may play lands and cast spells from among cards exiled with this enchantment.
{3}{R}: This enchantment deals 1 damage to target opponent or planeswalker.
blocked_sentences: {3}{R}: This enchantment deals 1 damage to target opponent or planeswalker.

needs.what: one target spec spanning players and permanents whose player half and permanent half carry separate filters: the player half restricted to opponents, the permanent half any planeswalker on the battlefield regardless of controller ("target opponent or planeswalker", 115.4)
needs.why_existing_wont_do: kind "any" applies one selector to both halves: _player_allowed reads its `controller` clause for the seat and resolve_pool/matches read the same `controller` for the object, so controller "opponent" + types [Planeswalker] wrongly excludes your own planeswalkers, and omitting controller wrongly lets you target yourself. The other two sentences are expressible: an upkeep-triggered look_at_top to exile with link: true, playable: "while_exiled" and playable_condition: "your_turn_opponent_lost_life_exiled_with_source".
